cases.note: Field weights rank an id hit (weight 6) above a title hit (weight 4), a headings hit (weight 2), and a body hit (weight 1)
A unit matching in both title and body outranks a text-window unit matching in title only
Exact question id matches the question unit in the exact class
Literal clause number 9904.401 in title outranks a unit that receives 9904.401 in body through the cas 401 glossary alias
Intermediate clause ancestor 15.404-1 finds a unit containing 15.404-1(a)(4)
Duplicate query tokens are removed so each distinct query token scores at most once
Exact term id with underscore is in the exact class and matches both split words
Multi-word alias query cas 401 ranks literal title match above synonym-expanded body match
